design.studentKey: seed*10000000 + episodeKey*1000 + round; network rng(key+2), cue rng(key+3), controller rng(key+501)
design.studentReset: resetState before every probe; same reset and key for all three conditions
design.schedule: student blank 0-240; DN 3141/3165 300 Hz 240-280; VPN cue 150 Hz 280-520; ordinary counts reset 330; frozen decision 520; no-learning call 620; end 680
design.technicalGates: exact triplets and weights; source expected bit >=18/23 each cue; stimulated target +1 mean spike and >other count >=22/23 each cue/bit; fixed-decoder cue recognition >=19/23 for no/bit0/bit1 and <=2/23 drop versus no
design.sensitivityGates: each student: bit0 versus bit1 >=7/69 action changes AND actual teacher-selected bit versus no-message >=4/69 changes, holding no-message MBON fixed
design.usefulnessGates: each student: teacher-selected branch >=4/69 more wins than both no-message and opposite bit, with helpful > harmful action changes versus each; all four students must pass

limitation: Student state resets before each new matched probe. This cannot reproduce the continuous student history of the prior teaching pilot; no reward or learning was delivered.
